intro: That problem is rarely solved by one more tool. It is solved by making the systems you already run agree with each other, deciding which numbers can be trusted, and putting the answer where someone acts on it. We do that work end to end, across software, data, AI and the hardware side where it reaches that far.
signals: Site reality and the plan diverging quietly between reporting cycles
Progress reported in documents written after the fact rather than from the systems
Equipment, materials and subcontractor data living in separate places

faqs.q: What does construction and infrastructure technology work involve?
faqs.a: Site reality and the plan diverging quietly, reported upward in documents written after the fact rather than from what the systems hold. The work is usually less about building something new and more about making what already exists agree with itself: integrating the systems holding the data, establishing which numbers can be trusted, and putting the result where a decision gets made. We cover software and systems engineering, applied AI and automation, and the hardware side where the problem reaches it.

faqs.q: How do you know whether this is worth building?
faqs.a: We look at volume, repeatability and what an error costs before proposing anything, and we say so when the work does not justify itself. Published data puts projects that defined the requirement before committing within about 10 to 15 percent of budget, against 30 to 60 percent over for projects that skipped it. The assessment is deliberately structured so that it can end in a no.

faqs.q: Have you worked in construction and infrastructure before?
faqs.a: Yes. Our published case studies are anonymized at our clients' request, so the engagements in this sector are not listed by name, and we will not imply otherwise. What we can do on a call is talk through the specific problem shape, what the work involved and what it took to make it hold up in production.

name: Construction and infrastructure
